{{Quote|Um… We'll have two of… whatever he's having.|Wim ordering the same type of noodles that the alien is having|<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />}}
An '''Onodone''' was present at a [[Unidentified noodle bar|noodle bar]] on [[Borgo Prime]]<ref name="PastTheBarrier" /> around [[9 ABY]]<ref name="SkeletonDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> when the [[youngling]]s [[Wim]] and [[Neel]] visited the establishment. While he was slurping his [[Unidentified noodle dish (Port Borgo)|noodles]] out of a tube, Wim decided to order two of what he was having. He did not speak to the children but glanced at them when they made their order. He was still at the noodle stand when Wim tried to pay the [[Unidentified fry cook|fry cook]] with an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] credit, which caused a stir about where the [[Gender|boys]] had found the valuable credit.<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />

==Behind the scenes==
The noodle eater first appeared in the "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="PastTheBarrier" /> which aired on [[December 2]] [[2024]].<ref name="SW:2024-08-10">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-official-trailer-key-art|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Official Trailer and Key Art Revealed}}</ref> He was performed by [[Bradley Schutt]].<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />
